metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Java) with deployable entry point (Struts Action deployed as WAR on WebLogic). Single-service web application with Oracle database persistence.
metadata.archetype_justification: Database connections with INSERT operations (Oracle 11g), form-based write endpoints (loan submission), entity lifecycle management. Classified as stateful-crud.

findings.title: No programmatic API — legacy form-based web UI only
findings.description: The application is a legacy Struts 1.3 web application that exposes only a form-based HTML interface via JSP pages. There is no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. Integration would require direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. The only integration surface is an HTML form-based Struts action mapped in struts-config.xml.
findings.recommendation: Expose the loan pricing calculation and submission as a REST API (e.g., Spring Boot with @RestController) alongside or replacing the Struts UI layer.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Expose loan pricing and submission as REST API endpoints
blocker_remediation.target_state: JSON-based REST API with documented endpoints for loan quote and loan submission

findings.title: No machine identity authentication mechanism
findings.description: The application has no machine identity authentication mechanism. It relies solely on container-managed authentication (request.getRemoteUser()) which provides no support for service accounts, API keys, OAuth2 client credentials, or mTLS.
findings.gap: No machine identity mechanism. No API key, OAuth2 client credentials, or mTLS configuration.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credentials authentication on any new API surface. Use AWS Cognito or API Gateway authorizers for machine identity.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credentials authentication
blocker_remediation.target_state: Machine identity with principal attribution supporting per-agent identity creation and revocation

findings.title: Write operations are not idempotent
findings.description: The loan submission endpoint performs a raw INSERT into the applications table with no idempotency protection. No idempotency key, no unique constraint on business keys, no duplicate detection. Repeated submissions create duplicate loan applications.
findings.gap: No idempotency key support. No unique constraint enforcement. The saveApplication method performs unconditional INSERT on every call.
findings.recommendation: Add an idempotency key parameter to the submission endpoint. Enforce a unique constraint on a business key.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency protection on write operations
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The loan submission endpoint performs unconditional INSERT without idempotency keys. Agent retries will duplicate loan applications.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add idempotency key parameter and unique business key constraint
blocker_remediation.target_state: Idempotent write operations where retries with same key produce exactly one record

findings.title: No audit logging for write operations
findings.description: No audit logging exists. The application has no logging of any kind. Write operations (loan submissions) are not logged with the authenticated principal. No immutable log storage.
findings.gap: No audit trail for write operations. No CloudTrail. No log immutability.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging (CloudTrail + S3 Object Lock) capturing principal for every write operation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing loan submissions have no audit trail. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics on agent-initiated writes.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add application-level audit logging for all write operations with principal attribution
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable audit logs capturing every agent-initiated write with principal attribution

findings.title: No compensation or rollback for loan submissions
findings.description: The application performs a single INSERT operation with no compensation, rollback, or saga pattern. No mechanism to undo a submitted loan application.
findings.gap: No rollback or compensation mechanism. No undo endpoint. No status field for cancellation.
findings.recommendation: Add a status field (PENDING, SUBMITTED, CANCELLED) and expose a cancellation endpoint.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation/rollback exists for write operations
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agent executing loan submission that fails mid-sequence leaves application in partial state with no recovery mechanism.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add status-based lifecycle with cancellation endpoint
blocker_remediation.target_state: Loan submissions enter PENDING state that can be cancelled or rolled back

findings.title: No scoped permissions — all users have identical access
findings.description: No authorization model exists in the application code. All authenticated users have identical access with no mechanism to scope down agent permissions.
findings.gap: No IAM policies, no RBAC, no scoped permissions. Single container-managed role grants full access.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control with at minimum read-only and write roles when building the new API surface.

compensating_controls: Restrict agent access at network layer
Implement API Gateway with IAM-based authorization

findings.title: No action-level authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. Quote and submit operations are not distinguished at the authorization level.
findings.gap: No ABAC or fine-grained RBAC. No action-level checks.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level permissions separating loan pricing from loan submission authorization.

compensating_controls: Limit agent scope to quote-only via orchestration layer
Add method-level auth in new API layer

findings.title: Database credentials hardcoded in source code
findings.description: Database credentials are hardcoded directly in the Java source code (DB_USER='loan_app', DB_PASS='loanApp2010'). Credentials are committed to source control in plain text with no rotation mechanism.
findings.gap: No secrets management. Credentials in source control. No rotation.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove hardcoded values immediately.

compensating_controls: Move credentials to environment variables as interim step

findings.title: No concurrency controls — known thread-safety bugs
findings.description: No concurrency controls exist. Unconditional INSERT with no optimistic locking. README confirms thread-safety bugs under load.
findings.gap: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no conditional writes. Known thread-safety issues.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version fields on the applications table.

compensating_controls: Limit concurrent agent instances to 1 for write operations

findings.title: No circuit breakers or resilience patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations exist. Raw JDBC connection with no timeout. Database outage causes requests to hang indefinitely.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns. No circuit breakers. No timeouts on JDBC connection.
findings.recommendation: Implement connection pooling with timeouts and circuit breaker patterns.

compensating_controls: Configure database connection timeouts at JDBC driver level
Add connection pool with timeout settings

findings.title: No rate limiting at any layer
findings.description: No rate limiting exists. No API Gateway, no WAF rules, no application-level rate limiting. A runaway agent could overwhelm the application at machine speed.
findings.gap: No rate limiting configuration. No throttling at any layer.
findings.recommendation: Deploy an API Gateway with usage plans and throttling limits in front of any agent-facing surface.

compensating_controls: Place API Gateway with rate limiting in front

findings.title: No transaction limits — unbounded blast radius
findings.description: No transaction limits exist. No configurable limits on operations per agent, per session, or per time window. An agent could submit unlimited loan applications.
findings.gap: No per-caller business transaction limits. No bulk operation caps. No spend thresholds.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-caller transaction limits (e.g., max loan submissions per hour per agent identity).

compensating_controls: Implement orchestration-layer limits on agent call frequency
Add database triggers to cap inserts

findings.title: Sensitive data exposed without field-level filtering
findings.description: The system stores applicant PII (names) and financial data (loan principal, rate, terms) without field-level filtering or access differentiation. All data accessible to any authenticated user.
findings.gap: No response scoping (B1). No access differentiation (B2). No classification metadata (B3).
findings.recommendation: Implement separate DTOs excluding sensitive fields from agent-facing responses. Add OAuth scopes for sensitive data access.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Stage A = Yes (PII/financial data). B1 = RISK-SAFETY (no field filtering). B2 = RISK-SAFETY (no access differentiation). Overall = RISK-SAFETY.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System stores PII and financial data. B1 fired: no API response filtering exists (Struts forms return all data). B2 fired: single role for all data access. Overall severity is RISK-SAFETY (highest sub-check).

b1.reasoning: No field-level filtering in API responses. Struts forms return all loan data including applicant name.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation. Single container-managed role grants access to all data.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata exists.

compensating_controls: Restrict agent access to read-only quote operations
Implement field-level filtering in new API layer

findings.title: No data residency policy for PII and financial data
findings.description: PII and financial data stored in Oracle database without documented residency policy or region enforcement. No mechanism prevents agent from transmitting data cross-jurisdiction.
findings.gap: No data residency policy. No region enforcement. No cross-region replication controls.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Configure agent integration to use same-region Bedrock endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: agent_scope=write-enabled but no explicit regulatory jurisdiction evidence. PII present without documented residency constraints.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores PII and financial data but has no documented regulatory jurisdiction (no GDPR/LGPD references). Evaluated as RISK-SAFETY rather than BLOCKER due to absence of explicit regulatory evidence.
compensating_controls: Configure agent to use same-region LLM endpoints only
Document data residency requirements before agent integration

findings.title: No machine-readable API specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or any machine-readable API specification exists. The only interface documentation is the Struts configuration.
findings.gap: No machine-readable specification for automated tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Generate an OpenAPI specification as part of API modernization.

findings.title: No structured error responses — HTML error pages only
findings.description: No structured error responses. Struts returns HTML error pages. No JSON error bodies, no error codes, no retryable indicators.
findings.gap: Errors are HTML pages, not machine-readable structured responses.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error code, message, and retryable flag.

findings.title: No input validation — SQL injection vulnerability present
findings.description: No input validation exists. SQL injection vulnerability via string concatenation with unsanitized user input (applicantName). No parameterized queries for user-provided data.
findings.gap: No validation library. No parameterized queries. SQL injection present.
findings.recommendation: Fix SQL injection immediately by using parameterized queries. Add input validation framework.

findings.title: No schema versioning or API contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no API contracts, no breaking change detection. Single unversioned Struts action mapping.
findings.gap: No versioning, no schema files, no contract tests.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and OpenAPI spec diffing from the start of API modernization.

findings.title: No distributed tracing or structured logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing and no structured logging. Zero observability into request processing. No correlation IDs.
findings.gap: No tracing, no structured logs, no correlation IDs.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry/X-Ray and structured JSON logging with correlation IDs.

findings.title: No alerting on error rates or latency
findings.description: No alerting. No CloudWatch alarms, no monitoring infrastructure, no SLOs defined.
findings.gap: No alerting on error rates or latency. No monitoring infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rates and P99 latency.

findings.title: No infrastructure as code — manual deployment only
findings.description: No IaC. Manual WAR deployment via WebLogic admin console. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK. No drift detection. No peer review.
findings.gap: No infrastructure as code. No change review. No drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define target infrastructure as IaC (Terraform or CDK) before agent integration.

findings.title: No CI/CD pipeline or automated testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Build is Apache Ant with JARs committed to source. No automated testing of any kind.
findings.gap: No CI/CD. No contract tests. No automated tests.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract tests when building new API surface.

findings.title: No rollback capability — manual WAR replacement only
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual WAR replacement is the only recovery mechanism. No blue/green, no canary, no feature flags.
findings.gap: No automated rollback. No deployment pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback (CodeDeploy or blue/green via ECS/EKS).

findings.title: No sandbox or staging environment in repository
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment configuration in the repository. README mentions shared UAT environment but no configuration exists in code.
findings.gap: No staging configuration, no Docker-compose, no seed data scripts.
findings.recommendation: Create production-equivalent staging environment with synthetic loan data.

findings.title: No identity propagation mechanism
findings.description: No identity propagation. Only request.getRemoteUser() for basic user identification. No JWT, no token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: No identity propagation mechanism. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange distinguishing agent service identity from delegated user identity.

findings.title: No agent identity suspension capability
findings.description: No agent identity mechanism exists, so suspension is not applicable. has_auth_surface is false — the system does not issue or enforce agent identities.
findings.gap: No identity suspension capability (no identity mechanism exists).
findings.recommendation: Include suspension/revocation in machine identity design (AUTH-Q1 dependency).

findings.title: No logging exists — PII-in-logs not currently a risk
findings.description: The application has no logging at all, so PII-in-logs is currently not a risk. When logging is added, PII redaction must be implemented since the system handles applicant names and financial data.
findings.gap: When logging is added, PII redaction must be implemented.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking middleware from day one when adding logging infrastructure.

items.summary: Resolve all BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Build programmatic API surface, implement machine identity, add audit logging, fix data integrity and security gaps.
Address remaining RISK-QUALITY findings. Add observability, CI/CD, IaC, and operational maturity controls.
Continuous improvement. All critical gaps addressed in phases 1-2.

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API surface replacing Struts form interface
recommended_actions.rationale: No programmatic API exists. This is the foundational blocker — all other agent integration depends on a callable API.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with machine identity support
recommended_actions.rationale: No machine identity, no scoped permissions, no action-level auth. Agent cannot be safely authenticated or authorized.

recommended_actions.action: Implement immutable audit logging with CloudTrail
recommended_actions.rationale: No audit trail for write operations. Compliance requirement for write-enabled agent deployment.

recommended_actions.action: Add transaction safety controls (idempotency, rollback, concurrency)
recommended_actions.rationale: Write operations have no idempotency, no rollback, and known concurrency bugs. Agent retries will corrupt data.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate credentials to secrets management and fix SQL injection
recommended_actions.rationale: Hardcoded credentials and SQL injection are immediate security vulnerabilities independent of agent integration.
Zero observability makes agent-initiated failures completely opaque. Required for operational readiness.
